target_customer: Boutique fitness, yoga, pilates and wellness studio owners, and experience businesses that sell classes and events
problem: Studios and experience businesses needed one place for scheduling, payments, memberships, marketing and a customer app, especially when classes moved online in 2020.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription plus embedded payments take rate

founders.name: Vojta Drmota
founders.background_notes: Originally from the Czech Republic and Sweden; interested in alternative payments per the YC page.

founders.name: Matteo Carroll
founders.background_notes: Originally from Brazil; interested in payments, e-commerce and consumer marketplaces per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Booking, memberships and payments are standard SaaS, but embedded payments and a consumer mobile app add moderate engineering and compliance work.

defensibility.rationale: Studios that run bookings, memberships and payments on one platform are costly to move, but the category already had many competing studio software products.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it in a documented way. Clubessential, a private equity backed membership software company, bought Momence in January 2025 to add to its fitness vertical.

market_need_then: Pandemic closures in 2020 pushed studios to sell online classes and memberships, creating demand for tools combining scheduling and payments for experiences.

branding.domain_note: Owns momence.com; acquisition story not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, supportive and practical, speaking to studio owners as partners: Build your studio, your way.

branding.community_and_virality: Trade press (Athletech News) ran customer stories about studios using Momence; no evidence of merch or fan community.

brand_strength.rationale: A short coined name. Trade press covered customer stories, yet there is no sourced evidence of a distinctive brand asset.

outcome_analysis: Momence launched in Summer 2020 as studios moved online, grew to a reported 75 person team and over 4500 business customers with hundreds of thousands of monthly bookings in its consumer app, and was acquired by Clubessential Holdings in January 2025. Terms were undisclosed and the round history is poorly sourced, but customer growth and a strategic buyer in the same vertical suggest a real product market fit exit.
notes: Funding is aggregator only, so unverified and no round recorded: SeedTable lists a seed dated 2020-08 led by Y Combinator with FundersClub, FJ Labs, Musha Ventures and ONEVC but no amount; CB Insights lists 2.5 million dollars over 7 rounds. Competitor list left empty: searches found no source dated near 2020 comparing Momence with Mindbody, Acuity or others. One review site claims Momence now sits under Xplor Technologies; single secondary source, unverified. Completeness pass: the seed dated 2020-08 rests on a single database (Seedtable) with no amount. CB Insights lists 2.5M dollars total over 7 rounds, so other rounds are likely missing. The Clubessential Holdings acquisition (announced 2025-01-29, terms undisclosed) is confirmed by press release.
